text: 近日，北京银行启动子公司管理人员公开招聘，其中包括旗下基金公司——中加基金总经理职务。事实上，自上一任总经理李莹于去年底离职后，中加基金总经理职务一直由首席信息官陈昕代任，目前代任时长已超过半年。如今，股东方启动公开招聘，或意在尽快填补总经理一职的长期空缺。（中国基金报）
text_en: Bank of Beijing recently launched a public recruitment for subsidiary management positions, including the general manager role at its fund unit, Bank of China Jiaming Fund. Since former general manager Li Ying departed late last year, CIO Chen Xin has been acting GM for over half a year. The shareholder's public recruitment may aim to fill the long-vacant position promptly. (China Fund News)
